english.note: Use this for a person or animal with little body fat; it is the all-purpose choice for the body-related sense.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying someone is skinny or thin, without stressing the bones.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 tai2 lok6 hou2 sau3

examples.english: I was bony when I was young.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 hou2 sau3

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for bodily leanness and lean meat.

examples.english: I quite like eating lean meat.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gei2 zung1 ji3 sik6 sau3 juk6
